name: DJI Matrice 4D Series Battery (model BPX230-6768-22.14), sold by RoboMaster as the "RoboMaster 新电池" robot battery

files.bbox_note: X across the two latch buttons (shell body 69.0, cap 88.0), Y thickness, Z length incl. cap. Top-level product 00_EA230_DRONE_BATTERY_ASM; shells 04_EA230_BATT_TOP_SHELL-V02 / 04_EA230_BATT_BOT_SHELL-V02, latches EA230_DRONE_BAT_LOCK_BUTTON_A/B, keypad 06_EA230_BATT_KEYPAD, connector 02_EA230_BATT_CON-F_*.
files.cad_colors_note: CAD colours are display colours (latch buttons 196,18,18 red, lock pins orange). Real latches are light grey.

files.original_name: 新电池及配套产品图纸.zip

provenance: Official full battery model (shell, cells, connector, latches) published by RoboMaster/DJI for teams; MD5 3ddff7b3a823351a3a6581c0a1f996e5 matches the RoboMaster wiki attachment. STEP header: Creo Parametric 2019, 00_EA230_DRONE_BATTERY_ASM, author dogrot.liu, 2024-11-01. Rejected alternative: DJI's "DJI Dock 3 - Matrice 4D Series - 3D Model" (aircraft, 135 MB, surface model) only contains the exposed rear cap of the battery (product M4D_BAT_1_1, about 96 x 59 x 35 mm); it is not used.
license: No explicit license. Published free by the RoboMaster organizing committee (DJI) for participant teams to design robots around the part; DJI copyright. Fine for rendering on our own site; do not redistribute the raw CAD file without checking with DJI/RoboMaster.

dims_mm.overall: 154.05 (length incl. cap) x 95.99 (across latch buttons) x 59.33 (thickness), from the official STEP
dims_mm.shell_body: about 69.0 wide x 58.1 thick x 138.7 long (bottom shell part); cap/top shell about 88.0 x 59.4 x 21.2
dims_mm.official_dims: DJI does not publish battery dimensions; the RoboMaster notice says 体积 详见图纸 (see drawings), i.e. the STEP is the dimensional source
dims_mm.features: cap end carries the power button + 4 battery-level LEDs, two spring latch buttons on the sides, and the 9-contact female connector (9x 02_EA230_BATT_CON-F_CONTACT-18A on 2.5 mm pitch) (02_EA230_BATT_CON-F_*) facing the rack/aircraft; ribbed black heat-sink grille on one side face; label panel on the large face; threaded inserts (EA230_BATT_PSDK_NUT) at the cap for parachute/payload mounting

mass_note: DJI spec 640 g (enterprise.dji.com/dock-3/specs). RoboMaster notice 1785 gives 650 g (pre-release figure).

colors.shell: light grey matte plastic (same grey as the Matrice 4D airframe); median of the studio photo is about #949495
colors.label_panel: darker grey printed label panel on the large face (white text, DJI logo)
colors.heatsink_grille: black ribbed grille on one side face
colors.cap_and_latches: light grey, latch levers slightly darker grey; power button with 4 green LEDs
colors.note: CAD colours (red latches, orange pins, dark-grey shells) are not product colours.

notes: RoboMaster switched to this battery for the 2025 season after the TB48S was discontinued; it is charged only through the Matrice 4D Series 240W Charging Hub (RoboMaster calls it the 新充电管家). In the robot it sits in Battery Rack 2. The same file is also in cad/raw/battery-rack-2/x/battery.stp.
